text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the JBC Classic. Smart Falcon 
and her Trainer were handing out flyers 
for the race."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she wanted as many people as 
possible to discover the thrill of dirt 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The flyers that used to be left over were 
all handed out, and a huge crowd of 
spectators had gathered at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing the rising popularity of dirt 
racing, Smart Falcon resolves to hype up 
the races so this momentum doesn't cool 
down.
